verdict.rationale: Gazebo is explicitly built for physics simulation (multiple physics engines like ODE, Bullet, DART), sensor/robot/environment plugins, and access to physically accurate robot models via Gazebo Fuel, directly supporting pre-hardware robot testing. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on validation of sensor realism accuracy, no third-party benchmarking against real hardware behavior, and no explicit sensor model list (cameras, lidar, IMU) beyond generic plugin mentions.
